acceptance: No speed claim unless all frozen correctness invariants pass. Report raw samples, paired ratios and all failures. JSON is a semantic control and does not use the nom wire parser.
frozen_invariants: Identical canonical envelope and payload for every accepted message in every arm.
New send accepted once; identical duplicate returns same sequence without spending message or byte budget.
Changed content under the same identity rejected without spending message or byte budget.
First receive has redelivered=false; next receive has redelivered=true; both contain exact accepted envelope.
ACK requires received addressed content; after ACK no pending delivery remains.
Final useful state: three received+ACKed messages, one completed worker reservation, same immutable evidence.
Final byte usage equals sum of canonical compact JSON envelope UTF-8 sizes, across all arms.
measurements: perf_counter_ns for each operation; constructor, cold first operation and shutdown reported separately.
Total useful-cycle wall time includes create, reservation/completion and all delivery checks, excludes shutdown.
Warm operation times exclude create; no startup samples silently mixed into warm metrics.
Actual subprocess launches recorded in parent and isolated Python descendants via explicit sitecustomize instrumentation.
Parent plus reaped-child CPU sampled via resource.getrusage; persistent child CPU is accounted after shutdown.
Codec-only encode and parse cold/warm timings and representation round trips measured separately.
cProfile diagnostic runs kept separate from headline timings.
purpose: Measure equivalent deterministic durable delivery; no inference, accuracy, token or billing claim.
schedule: Rotate the four arms by repetition (counterbalanced Latin-square). Same payloads and identifiers; fresh database per arm/repetition.
scope_limits: One local host and deterministic software workload.
No live agents or model output accuracy measured.
Small finite paired sample; descriptive ratios are not population inference.
